newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MMS sets new dates for oil valuation meetings.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MMS sets new dates for oil valuation meetings.

text.p: The U.S. Minerals Management Service on Friday corrected a notice issued Thursday, setting new dates for public meetings on its proposal to change the way it assesses royalties for oil produced on federal lands.
The public meetings have been postponed to April 17 in Houston, Texas and April 15 in Denver, Colorado.
MMS earlier said the meetings had been rescheduled to March 27 in Houston and April 3 in Lakewood, Colorado.
The meetings have been delayed to give industry more time to prepare comments on the controversial plan.
MMS last month proposed to base royalty calculations on crude oil futures prices instead of basing them on company posted prices, saying that posted prices undervalued the oil.
